location.description: notion:// backs up everything shared with the integration, notion://<page or database id> a single subtree

token.description: Internal integration token (ntn_...). Falls back to the NOTION_TOKEN environment variable.

comments.description: Which comments to back up: blocks (every discussion, at one request per block), pages (the page-level discussions only, one request per page) or none. With pages or none, unchanged pages cost two requests on later backups.

users.description: Back up the list of workspace members (needs the user information capability).

views.description: Back up the views of each database.

rate.description: Requests per second to Notion. The default of 3 fits every plan; Business and Enterprise workspaces may use up to 10.

api_url.description: Base URL of the Notion API, for tests.
